title_en: In Shallvaret, 2+1 Office Apartment For Sale!
description_en: Very close to the Center, in the area of ​​Shallvareve, very close to Gjergj Fishta Boulevard, 2+1 street corner apartment for sale. The environment is located on the first floor of a well-managed 5-story building without an elevator. The environment is organized in two rooms, a cooking area and a toilet with a window. The environment is suitable for a variety of offices such as: Notary/Law Office, Design Office, IT Office, Finance Office and for a variety of other activities. The property has full mortgage documentation. The area in which the environment is located has high mobility and very close access to the city center.
